* fix: ops functions write through the wrapper's own __setitem__/__delitem__ (#3)

The free functions in cosmodol.ops now perform the plain mapping write on the
caller's store, with a one-shot ContextVar redirect (cosmodol.routing) telling
the leaf how to execute the single write that reaches it. Every layer's write
logic runs: write guards, preset hooks, write-through caches, and filt_iter
scopes on keys an operation creates. Swallowed/deferred/multiplied writes raise
RedirectError. batch_items patch on a wrapped or subclassed store needs
unguarded_patch=True.

Closes #3

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: pin each redirect to its expected leaf key; re-raise swallowed errors

Adversarial review of #3: a layer that writes another key first (companion
container, audit record) received the operation's semantics; now the leaf
refuses any write but the expected (method, key). Errors a layer catches are
re-raised; subclasses scoping by __contains__ are checked; messages no longer
claim a deferred write was not performed.
